verdicts.explanation: The paper reports 6.51 (±0.36) × 10−7 S/cm at 35C for the non-air-exposed Pt/LPZ-300/Li half cell, read as the bulk resistance Rb. The 0.55 eV activation energy is given for that same non-air-exposed LPZ-300 sample, and the experimental origin is correct.

The paper states the total ionic conductivity (Rr + Rb) of 1.6 (±0.1) × 10−7 S/cm for air-exposed LPZ-300 at 35C. The 0.64 eV activation energy is for air-exposed LPZ-300, and the unit and origin are correct.
The paper gives 1.4 (±0.14) × 10−7 S/cm as the total conductivity of LPZ-250 at 35C. No activation energy is reported for LPZ-250, so the null is correct.
